title: UN Commission finding on attacks affecting Gaza hospitals
summary: The Commission examined Israeli military operations affecting hospitals during the period through 31 December 2023.
claim: The Commission found that attacks on and the siege of health-care facilities impaired Gaza’s health system and access to medical care, and that the Israeli security forces’ conduct constituted the war crime of intentionally directing attacks against civilian objects.
legal_characterization: War-crime finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the cited paragraphs of A/HRC/56/26 and the Commission methodology in paragraphs 3-7, including its reasonable-grounds standard. This is attributed to the Commission and is not a court judgment or an individual conviction. Classification judgment: the report discusses multiple health facilities and legal rules; manual review should confirm this narrowly combined formulation.
